name: BlogNav
description: Blog article sub-navigation: a back-to-articles action plus previous/next controls for stepping through the article sequence.

ariaRequirements: Wrapped in a nav landmark labelled via aria-label (blogNavLabel)
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-06 alpha->beta: axe clean via test-storybook a11y test:error across base + light + dark + forced-colors on all stories; 4-mode AT snapshots captured and compare-clean. Rendered in a nav landmark labelled via blogNavLabel (en/fi/sv); labels collapse below 768px but each button keeps its Icon aria-label. Composes verified beta Button/Icon primitives; no own animation.

dense: Blog article sub-navigation: back-to-articles plus prev/next stepping for article pages

usage.description: Sub-navigation for blog articles. Renders a back-to-articles action and previous/next controls that step through the article sequence, disabling the edges (and both when the route is not an article). Blog chrome; for site-wide nav use SiteHeader/NavLink.
